name: More from Kiwix
description: Further archives from the Kiwix library: programming documentation from DevDocs, more Project Gutenberg shelves, medical and science references, courses, talks, and material on low-tech living and preparedness. Every entry is fetched from Kiwix's own servers at the moment you ask for it; nothing is bundled with Outpost.
